hacker-crash-stance-movement.head: 07f20cba
hacker-crash-stance-movement.scope: Native selected Crash with seven records and the two effect lifetimes; helper lands the same stack on the stock CSR, showing 1301→599→1285 stock displacement and exact −0.50 then zero.

targeting.source: GOB 396 is a selected hostile viral cast, with the ordinary live view/spawn, range and sight rules.
targeting.runtime: AbilityHandler admits the original opposing spawn before cost and revalidates it at the common viral landing.
targeting.test: StarterViralDebuffRequiresTheOriginalHostileSpawnAtLanding, the exact stock-wire replay and PR864 cover stale, ally, empty, shared resolution and real opposing target. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/864#issuecomment-7087906306

stats.source: The shipped Crash stores 115/877/878/520 −50 and 519 −15 for 28 s, plus Viral and Ballistic Accuracy −27 for 42 s. Force Combat has an explicit duration even though its DurationType is omitted.
stats.runtime: AbilityHostile adds the raw records. AbilityBuffs uses one signed movement channel, and the normal Force Combat, evasion and accuracy consumers read their own records.
stats.test: CrashAppliesOneMovementPenaltyInEachStanceAndRestoresItFirst checks all stances and both expiration windows. Native PR864 receives seven records, and ordinary owner/observer movement goes to −0.50 and returns to zero while the accuracy debuff continues. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/864#issuecomment-7087906306

behavior-tests.source: GOB 396 costs 25 IS, casts for 4 s and has 15 s own reuse, with no direct health effect.
behavior-tests.runtime: The native-selected cast and helper with a captured stock request share the same ordinary handler and effect application.
behavior-tests.test: Native PR864 observed 25 IS/4 s/15 s, no interlock or damage and forward runs 1301→599→1285. The exact disposable bootstrap confirms companion owner/observer records and the separate 28/42 second removals. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/864#issuecomment-7087906306
